name: notasnet-mcp
description: Local MCP server for the Notasnet school portal (syscol.com/notasnet): agenda, grades, attendance, communications and more, as MCP tools.
long_description: Wraps the notasnet-client library and exposes its read endpoints (students, agenda, grades, attendance, observations, schedule, folders, account, institutional info) plus login/session tools over stdio. Auth uses Notasnet's real session cookie, captured via a `notasnet_login` tool call or (optionally) automatic login from configured credentials. See this extension's README for the full tool list and how to obtain the required app API key.

baseUrl.title: Base URL
baseUrl.description: Base URL of the Notasnet deployment. Leave default unless you know otherwise.

colegio.title: Colegio (slug)
colegio.description: School slug from the Notasnet login URL (e.g. "altomonte" in syscol.com/notasnet/login?colegio=altomonte). Optional here — you can also pass it directly to the notasnet_login tool.

apiKey.title: App API key
apiKey.description: Fixed, non-secret application key required by Notasnet's login endpoint (NOT your password — see this extension's README, section "Autenticación", for how to obtain it once from your browser's network tab).

usuario.title: Usuario / RUT
usuario.description: Your Notasnet username (usually your RUT). Optional: if set together with password, colegio and apiKey, the server logs in automatically on startup. Otherwise, use the notasnet_login tool interactively instead of storing your password here.

password.title: Contraseña
password.description: Your Notasnet password. Stored by your desktop app's secret storage, not in this manifest — but consider using the notasnet_login tool interactively instead of configuring this.
